question_en:
The Community Nature Center wants to use the list of invasive plants in the image for volunteer training in another park network. Using all scientific names listed in the image as the complete scope, please answer the following questions:

1. Which agency published the official list in the image, and which plant scientific names are listed in it?
2. In the invasive plant guide issued by this agency for the Mojave Desert National Park Network, which plants have individual species cards matching their scientific names, and which do not? Please provide a complete table of "Scientific Name — Has Card/No Card".

The answer must first state the publishing agency for Question 1, and then combine the plant scientific names with the verification results from Question 2 into a single complete table of "Scientific Name — Has Card/No Card".
answer:
1. Publishing Agency: Yosemite National Park, National Park Service (NPS), USA.

2.

| Scientific Name | Has Card/No Card |
| --- | --- |
| Acroptilon repens | Has Card |
| Anthoxanthum odoratum | No Card |
| Brachypodium distachyon | No Card |
| Brassica tournefortii | Has Card |
| Centaurea iberica | No Card |
| Dittrichia graveolens | No Card |
| Euphorbia oblongata | No Card |
| Euphorbia virgata | No Card |
| Glyceria declinata | No Card |
| Lepidium chalepense | No Card |
| Linaria dalmatica | No Card |
| Myriophyllum aquaticum | No Card |
| Myriophyllum spicatum | No Card |
| Onopordum acanthium | Has Card |
| Stipa miliacea var. miliacea | No Card |

| Isatis tinctoria | No Card |
| Spartium junceum | Has Card |
